metadata.description: 10 global zones grouped by cultural/economic similarity using Hofstede dimensions
metadata.grouping_logic: Countries with similar PDI, IDV, MAS, UAI, LTO, IVR scores are grouped together

east_asia.name: East Asia
east_asia.hofstede_profile: High MAS (70-95), High UAI (85-92), High LTO (75-88), Medium IDV (18-46)
dominant_cultural_traits: High LTO — invest in slow change

southeast_asia.name: Southeast Asia
southeast_asia.hofstede_profile: High PDI (64-94), Low-Medium IDV (14-39), Medium MAS (45-64), Low-Medium UAI (12-44)

south_asia.name: South Asia
south_asia.hofstede_profile: High PDI (70-80), Low IDV (14-48), Medium MAS (50-56), Low IVR/Restrained (20-26)
south_asia.trust_layer: Family, caste, religious community, village, ASHA/BRAC workers

central_asia.name: Central Asia
central_asia.hofstede_profile: High PDI (75-95), Low IDV (10-25), High MAS (50-65), High UAI (60-85)

mena.name: Middle East & North Africa
mena.hofstede_profile: High PDI (65-80), Low IDV (25-38), Medium MAS (45-65), High UAI (60-85), Low IVR (20-40)
dominant_cultural_traits: Family-centric — extended family as safety net

east_africa.name: East Africa
east_africa.hofstede_profile: Medium-High PDI (60-85), Low IDV (15-25), Medium MAS (55-65), Medium UAI (45-55), Low IVR (25-44)
east_africa.trust_layer: Church, family, ethnic community, market women, chama groups

west_africa.name: West Africa
west_africa.hofstede_profile: High PDI (70-80), Low-Medium IDV (20-30), Medium MAS (55-65), Medium UAI (45-55), High IVR (60-84 in Nigeria)
west_africa.economic_range: T2 (Nigeria, Ghana) to T3-T4 (Niger, Mali, Burkina Faso)
dominant_cultural_traits: Nigeria's high indulgence (84) — people express needs freely
west_africa.trust_layer: Ethnic community, church/mosque, market associations, trade guilds

central_south_africa.name: Central & Southern Africa
central_south_africa.hofstede_profile: High PDI (75-85), Very Low IDV (15-25), Medium-High MAS (55-65), Medium UAI (45-55), Very Low IVR (15-20)
central_south_africa.economic_range: T2 (South Africa) to T4 (DRC conflict zones)
dominant_cultural_traits: Family as only trust layer in conflict zones
central_south_africa.trust_layer: Family, clan, church (DRC); Institutions, community orgs (South Africa)

latin_america.name: Latin America
latin_america.hofstede_profile: High PDI (60-80), Low-Medium IDV (12-46), Medium-High MAS (50-65), Medium UAI (60-100), High IVR (40-68)
latin_america.economic_range: T1 (Chile urban) to T3 (Bolivia, Guatemala rural)
latin_america.trust_layer: Family, neighborhood, church, social enterprise networks

europe.name: Europe
europe.hofstede_profile: Low-Medium PDI (35-55), High IDV (67-89), Medium MAS (42-66), Medium-High UAI (55-86), Medium-High LTO (55-83)
